before:
-- Hyprland can leave the Wayland pointer target stale when the scrolling
-- layout moves beneath a stationary cursor. Re-hit-test the unchanged cursor
-- position after the layout has settled so the next wheel/touchpad axis event
-- reaches the surface now under it without requiring a physical pointer move.
local pointer_refocus_delay_ms = 50
local pointer_refocus_timer
local pointer_refocus_deferred = false
local pointer_refocus_pending = false

local function refocus_stationary_pointer()
  -- Repeat timers re-arm before their callback; keep this one reusable but
  -- dormant until another navigation action schedules it.
  pointer_refocus_timer:set_enabled(false)

  local cursor = hl.get_cursor_pos()
  if cursor then
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.cursor.move({ x = cursor.x, y = cursor.y }))
  end
end

pointer_refocus_timer = hl.timer(refocus_stationary_pointer, {
  timeout = pointer_refocus_delay_ms,
  type = "repeat",
})
pointer_refocus_timer:set_enabled(false)

local function finish_navigation(result)
  if (not result or result.ok ~= false) and (not result or result.changed ~= false) then
    if pointer_refocus_deferred then
      -- Keep the pointer target stable for the lifetime of a touchpad gesture.
      pointer_refocus_pending = true
    else
      -- Refresh now for synchronous moves, then once more after rendered layout
      -- changes settle. Re-arming debounces repeated edge moves into one tail.
      refocus_stationary_pointer()
      pointer_refocus_timer:set_timeout(pointer_refocus_delay_ms)
    end
  end

  return result
end

-- The shell's local helper calls these two functions through hyprctl repl.
omarchy_tape_bar = require("hypr.tape-bar").new(hl, tape, finish_navigation)
after:
-- Shared tape integration owns RPCs, lifecycle repair and pointer refresh.
local tape_integration = require("hypr.tape-bootstrap").new(hl, tape, require("hypr.tape-bar"))
local finish_navigation = tape_integration.finish_navigation
omarchy_tape_bar = tape_integration.bar

before:
-- window.close is emitted while the column still exists. Repair only the next
-- event-loop turn, after native removal, and only if no tape action intervened.
local tape_close_token
local tape_close_timer
tape_close_timer = hl.timer(function()
  tape_close_timer:set_enabled(false)
  local token = tape_close_token
  tape_close_token = nil
  if not pointer_refocus_deferred then finish_navigation(tape.finish_close(token)) end
end, { timeout = 1, type = "repeat" })
tape_close_timer:set_enabled(false)
local _tape_close_events = hl.on("window.close", function(window)
  if pointer_refocus_deferred then return end
  tape_close_token = tape_close_token or tape.prepare_close(window)
  if tape_close_token then tape_close_timer:set_timeout(1) end
end)

-- Fullscreen exit restores the column width before native camera fitting has
-- finished. Repair its outer boundary on the next event-loop turn; otherwise a
-- final half column can sit on the left with an empty right half. A short tape
-- then has no browsing stops even though a neighbor is offscreen.
local fullscreen_exit_token
local fullscreen_exit_timer
fullscreen_exit_timer = hl.timer(function()
  fullscreen_exit_timer:set_enabled(false)
  local token = fullscreen_exit_token
  fullscreen_exit_token = nil
  if token and not pointer_refocus_deferred then
    finish_navigation(tape.finish_fullscreen_exit(token))
  end
end, { timeout = 1, type = "repeat" })
fullscreen_exit_timer:set_enabled(false)
local _tape_fullscreen_events = hl.on("window.fullscreen", function(window)
  if window.fullscreen ~= 0 then return end
  fullscreen_exit_token = tape.prepare_fullscreen_exit(window)
  if fullscreen_exit_token then fullscreen_exit_timer:set_timeout(1) end
end)

local function begin_pointer_refocus_deferral()
  -- A pending keyboard tail must not re-target the pointer while the swipe
  -- protocol is active. Fold it into the post-gesture refresh instead.
  if pointer_refocus_timer:is_enabled() then
    pointer_refocus_pending = true
    pointer_refocus_timer:set_enabled(false)
  end

  pointer_refocus_deferred = true
end

local function flush_pointer_refocus()
  pointer_refocus_deferred = false

  if pointer_refocus_pending then
    pointer_refocus_pending = false
    pointer_refocus_timer:set_timeout(pointer_refocus_delay_ms)
  end
end
